verdict.rationale: Puzzle is a full-ledger accounting product where a bank-reconciliation workflow is a natural expected capability, but the evidence pack only shows categorization, AI close, and batch-categorize features — none of it describes a reconciliation view that surfaces matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions against the ledger. missing for 10: any doc/screenshot of a reconciliation screen, explicit unmatched/duplicate transaction flagging, or accountant workflow for clearing bank line items.
